body: Cyberspace regulator; State planner; Industry ministry
kind_of_act: Reported: told companies not to buy
source: Financial Times, Aug 20, 2025
text: The cyberspace regulator, the state planner and the industry ministry move to dissuade companies from buying Nvidia's H20, the Financial Times reports. By its account the cyberspace regulator gave an informal notice, "window guidance", "instructing them to halt new orders for Nvidia's H20 chips", about a week after Jul 15; the industry ministry spoke with executives to back that; and the state planner asked them to refrain from "purchasing all Nvidia chips, including the H20". The same article gives a second reason for held-off orders: some firms wanted to see whether a better Nvidia chip for China would come.
words: the Cyberspace Administration of China (CAC), the National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC) and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) moved in response / A group of Chinese regulators have mobilised in an effort to dissuade domestic tech companies from acquiring the H20
